split: First 48 unique-context information_extraction rows with 31–85 context words and 1–12 response words; first32 train, next8 validation, last8 test.
leakagePolicy: Disjoint source row, exact prompt and context; categories recur. Filters fixed before training. No benchmark representativeness claim.
changes: Filtered subset; added stable row IDs and fixed splits. Original instruction/context/response retained verbatim.
